title: MarketForecast
description: One forecast for a product and horizon with a calibrated interval. NGSI-LD-compatible draft v0.1.

targetPeriod.description: ISO week (2027-W14) or month (2027-04) the forecast addresses

horizon.description: Decision horizon the forecast supports, e.g. 'sell-timing-2w', 'planting-next-season'

intervalCoverageTarget.description: Nominal coverage of the calibrated (conformal) interval, e.g. 0.8

sourceRefs.description: ids of the PriceObservation records the forecast is built on (feature-level provenance)
